serviceIdentification.serviceAcronym: Supply Chain Master Catalog (SCMC) Government Cloud Solution
serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Offered as a SaaS solution, Prodigo Marketplace is a virtual e-commerce procurement product that enables maximum, sustained cost savings throughout VA's healthcare supply chain for all clinical and non-clinical supplies and services. By effectively driving contract utilization at the point-of-requisition, Prodigo Marketplace assures users are purchasing the right items from the right vendors at the right price. As VA's single purchasing gateway, enabled and sustained via Booz Allen Hamilton's secure cloud infrastructure, Prodigo Marketplace directs users to their preferred sources of supply. This online requisitioning tool offers users a simple, easy-to-use ordering experience; reducing clinical disruption and the time users spend on administrative tasks.
